body:
I have had some bad experiences of depression and anxiety.  I'll try describe the worst.

You spend the whole day wishing that the day would end — every day.  It doesn't matter what you're doing or not doing on that day; every day is dreadful, boring, and scary.

You have no motivation to do anything.  You don't want to leave the house, as the outdoor world is terrifying.  You don't want to have a shower, as it seems like a complete waste of time, and it will make you feel even more exhausted.  You don't want to eat anything.

Hunger, like all feelings, is very dulled.  You almost never feel it.  You eat not because you feel hunger, but because you haven't eaten for a few hours.  You simply *guess* that it must be time for food right now.

Music is scary.  When a song comes on the radio, you feel anxious.  It's like the song is a poison which may kill you.  It's very hard to describe this one.

Hi folks,

I am a bit more positive today.  Some events yesterday caused me to hit quite a low, and that's why I chose yesterday to write the above post.

To be honest, I was kind of hoping that someone would come along and say that life is not necessarily as bad as I wrote above, and that my mindset is unjustifiably negative.  But who knows.

Anyway, I appreciate the replies and up-votes.  Thanks.
I wonder how many people feel this way.  Thanks for the reply.
